correctness.rationale: Exact local multiplicative formulas give R_p(a)=p(1+p^(−a))/(p−1), strictly decreasing in exponent. The p=2 factor excludes every even n, and p^a single support yields only 3. For two odd supports p<q: p≥5 gives the sharp (5,7) maximum; p=3,q≥11 gives sharp (a,q,b)=(2,11,1); q=7 is separated by b=1 or b≥2 bounds; q=5 forces a≡2 (mod4) for b≥2, and a=2 or a≥6 lie strictly above or below 2. Exact rational identities verify 3,35,99 and sharp boundary 1045. Finite verifier independently factors every n≤10^6, but infinite scope rests entirely on these inequalities and congruences.

value.rationale: The multiplier-two ratio of divisor sums to Euler totient is a published natural problem. Passing to unitary divisors changes the first nonsquarefree layer: 99 is a new type absent from ordinary σ classifications. The complete exact first-two-support classification, global even obstruction, and three-prime sharp boundary form a motivated finite structural theorem, not an arbitrary bounded search or merely a restatement of previously tabulated squarefree solutions.
